title: The Prison Cell That Reversed Time for Its Inmates

hook: A scientist gave ants unlimited food and space — they built a colony so complex it had highways, farms, and a sewage system.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of insects creating a hidden civilization fascinates audiences and feels like discovering a secret world.
